stem: On a perpendicular graphical net representing Q on both axes, plot the point $D(\frac{5}{2},-\frac{3}{2})$. Tap the point.
solution: Move 2.5 units right along the x-axis.

hints.text: The first number is the position along the horizontal axis and the second is the height.
Check the sign of each number to see which way to move.
Write the fractions as decimals first, then count along each axis in steps of one half.
